question: Write a loop that prints every odd number smaller than n, and explain how it relates to this loop.
answer: for (int i = 1; i < n; i += 2) System.out.println(i); This does on purpose what the given loop does by accident: the given loop also steps i by 2, because i++ is in both the body and the header. If I wanted more than one statement repeated I would add braces.
